headline: DOLLAR HITS 1-YEAR HIGH; GOLD FALLS BELOW $4,000 — SILVER PLUNGES 5% AS FED RATE BETS SPIKE TO 68%
snippet: Gold broke below $4,000 on June 24 as the U.S. dollar climbed to its highest level in over a year against a basket of major currencies, pushing spot to $3,987 on June 25 — its lowest since November 2025 — while silver tumbled 5% in a single session as CME FedWatch data showed markets pricing a September rate hike at approximately 68%, up from 29% a week earlier. The FOMC's revised June projections placed the median 2026 policy rate at 3.8% and PCE inflation at 3.6%, effectively validating a hawkish path that has now fully unwound the rate-cut premium that fuelled gold's January run to $5,589.

headline: GOLDMINING TRADES NEAR CASH: $1.5B COMBINED PEA NPV, $185M BALANCE SHEET, THREE DRILLS TURNING (GLDG)
source_name: PR Newswire / GoldMining Inc. (NYSE American: GLDG)
snippet: GoldMining Inc. (NYSE American: GLDG) released its mid-year 2026 shareholder update on June 25 confirming two completed PEAs — La Mina (Colombia) at US$1.0 billion after-tax NPV5% and 32% IRR, and São Jorge (Brazil) at US$532 million NPV5% with 50,000+ oz/yr over an 11-year mine life — while holding approximately US$185 million in cash and publicly-traded securities with zero debt, an amount that nearly matches the entire market capitalization of the company. Three drill rigs are currently active across GoldMining's 13.1-million-ounce AuEq Measured-and-Indicated global resource base: two at São Jorge in Brazil and one at the Yarumalito project in Colombia.

headline: MINERALS 260 HITS HIGH-GRADE AT BULLABULLING — 10 RIGS, 78,000m DRILLED; PFS DUE JULY, MRE UPDATE AUGUST (ASX:MI6)
snippet: Minerals 260 Limited (ASX: MI6) reported June 25 new assay results from 60 drill holes totalling 14,935 metres across the Phoenix, Bacchus, and Dicksons deposits at its wholly-owned 4.5Moz Bullabulling Gold Project in Western Australia, with highlights of 20 metres at 3.4 g/t gold from 93 metres and 18 metres at 2.9 g/t gold from 332 metres — bringing the total drilling program since the prior MRE to 78,000 metres across 10 rigs simultaneously on site. A PFS and Maiden Ore Reserve are targeted for July 2026 and an updated Mineral Resource Estimate for August 2026, placing Bullabulling on a rapid development timeline for one of the Eastern Goldfields' largest undeveloped gold projects.

headline: FOUNDERS METALS DISCOVERS NEW ZONE 1.2KM WEST — 53.1m AT 1.21 g/t AU FROM SURFACE; FROYO ADDS 9m AT 12.21 g/t (TSXV:FDR)
snippet: Founders Metals Inc. (TSXV: FDR) announced June 23 a brand-new gold discovery 1.2 kilometres west of Upper Antino — a previously untested area — where hole FR217 returned 53.1 metres of 1.21 g/t gold from surface on a target that did not exist on the company's maps four months ago. Simultaneously at the Froyo Zone, hole FR230 intersected 9.0 metres at 12.21 g/t gold from 320 metres vertical depth and 37.0 metres at 3.27 g/t gold from 209 metres in the same hole, demonstrating that Upper Antino's high-grade system is strongly mineralised at depth — collectively extending the footprint of the Antino Gold Project in southeastern Suriname across multiple new corridors.

headline: GEORGIA JOINS CENTRAL BANK GOLD RUSH: $100M PURCHASED, $500M MORE PLANNED — TARGETS 25% GOLD RESERVE
snippet: The National Bank of Georgia purchased approximately US$100 million in gold last month — adding roughly 0.7 tonnes at May's average price and raising its total reserves to nearly 8 tonnes, with gold now representing 15.5% of all monetary reserves — and President Natia Turnava announced plans to buy an additional US$500 million to push gold's share to 25%, adding Georgia to a growing list of smaller central banks diversifying away from U.S. dollar-denominated assets. Published June 23 by Money Metals, the story illustrates how even mid-tier central banks are now acting on the structural de-dollarisation thesis that has driven above-1,000-tonne annual central bank gold purchasing for three consecutive years.

headline: GOLD'S 28% CORRECTION IS PAINFUL — HISTORY SAYS EVERY SECULAR GOLD BULL HAS HAD ONE JUST LIKE IT
snippet: A June 24 Kitco analysis frames gold's 28% decline from its January $5,589 all-time high in historical context, noting that every major secular gold bull market — including the 2001–2011 and 2015–2020 cycles — included at least one correction of 20–30% before resuming to new all-time highs, and that the current setup (persistently high central bank tonnage demand, a record sixth annual silver supply deficit, and ETF outflows that have already begun reversing) looks structurally closer to a correction low than a trend reversal. The analysis cautions that the timing of the bottom remains uncertain given the Fed's newly hawkish June projections, but argues that disciplined averaging into sustained sub-$4,000 gold represents the best risk-reward entry point of the 2024–2026 bull cycle.

headline: CATL'S JIANXIAWO RESTART TALK SINKS LITHIUM CARBONATE 10% IN TWO SESSIONS — 10-WEEK LOW AT 157,000 CNY/T
snippet: Lithium carbonate in China dropped approximately 10% in two trading sessions to a 10-week low of 157,000 yuan per tonne after Jiangxi Province issued a preliminary government land assessment fuelling speculation that CATL's Jianxiawo mine — forcibly idled in August 2025 when its operating permit expired — could be approaching restart, with Citigroup noting the market had priced in a near-term resumption despite no confirmed timeline or regulatory approval. Jianxiawo accounts for approximately 3% of global lithium production, meaning any confirmed restart would add meaningful supply at a time when lithium demand from battery storage is accelerating, though Citi and the broader buy side still expect supply-demand dynamics to remain tight through H2 2026.

headline: JUNE 30 DEADLINE: COMMERCE DEPT REPORT COULD TRIGGER 15–30% PHASED TARIFF ON REFINED COPPER FROM 2027
snippet: The U.S. Secretary of Commerce must deliver an updated assessment of domestic copper refining capacity and refined copper markets to the President by June 30, 2026 — five days away — and the report will determine whether the administration proceeds with a phased universal import duty on refined copper of 15% starting January 1, 2027, rising to 30% on January 1, 2028, on top of existing 50% tariffs already imposed on copper semi-finished products. Goldman Sachs estimates that a 25%-or-higher tariff on refined copper would widen the CME-to-LME price spread by $0.30–$0.80 per pound, materially increasing the economic case for North American copper explorers and developers with near-term domestic production potential.

headline: LUCA MINING EL REY VMS: 28.4m AT 2.3 g/t AU, 135 g/t AG, 3.7% ZN AT CAMPO MORADO MINE (TSXV:LUCA)
snippet: Luca Mining Corp. (TSXV: LUCA) released June 23 surface drillhole CMRY-26-10 results from the El Rey Zone at its producing Campo Morado polymetallic VMS mine in Guerrero, Mexico, intersecting 28.4 metres of 2.28 g/t gold, 134.89 g/t silver, 0.57% copper, 0.95% lead, and 3.69% zinc from 104.2 metres depth — expanding the known El Rey Zone mineralisation footprint at an operating mine that generates near-term cash flow, reducing the capital risk typical of exploration-stage junior positions. The multi-metal intercept at an already-permitted and producing VMS system stands out in the current market context as a lower-risk way to gain exposure to gold, silver, zinc, and copper simultaneously.

headline: COT JUNE 22: GOLD AND SILVER LIQUIDATION EXTENDS — MANAGED MONEY POSITIONING AT MULTI-MONTH BEARISH EXTREME
snippet: GoldSeek's June 22 weekly Commitment of Traders analysis of gold, silver, and the U.S. Dollar Index found that managed money's net long positioning in COMEX gold and silver has reached a multi-month bearish extreme as institutional liquidation extends into the correction from January's $5,589 high — a level of positioning contraction that historically has preceded the largest recoveries in both metals, as overcrowded short or flat positioning reverses mechanically once the macro narrative shifts. The dollar index's concurrent rise to resistance and the extreme in futures positioning together form the sentiment backdrop that contrarian analysts are watching as the primary leading indicator for the next gold and silver entry window.

headline: ASHLEY GOLD TAK PHASE 1 FINAL: 1.5 g/t AU OVER 10.25m NEAR SURFACE, D99Z WIDTH EXTENDS TO 100m+ (CSE:ASHL)
snippet: Ashley Gold Corp. (CSE: ASHL) reported June 23 the final Phase 1 assay results from its Tak Patents drill campaign in the Dryden Area of northwestern Ontario, with TAK-26-04 returning 0.996 g/t gold over 16 metres including 1.505 g/t gold over 10.25 metres from near surface within a broader 118-metre envelope of anomalous gold values — extending the D99Z zone to over 100 metres width and confirming gold mineralisation in all five Phase 1 holes. Phase 2 drilling is currently underway on the 67Z target with four holes pending assay, and 32 prospecting grab samples remain pending along strike, building toward a bulk-tonnage near-surface gold resource definition in an established gold camp.

headline: HARFANG HITS Cu-Au-Ag AT MISTA IN JAMES BAY QUÉBEC — INTRUSION SYSTEM OPENS NEW SERPENT PROJECT FRONT (TSXV:HAR)
source_name: Globe and Mail / Harfang Exploration Inc. (TSXV:HAR)
snippet: Harfang Exploration Inc. (TSXV: HAR) announced June 24 first assay results from 1,188 metres of drilling in six holes at the Mista target of its wholly-owned Serpent Project in Eeyou Istchee James Bay, Québec, returning multiple mineralised intercepts including 4.30 metres at 0.47% copper, 0.22 g/t gold, and 6.76 g/t silver, and a 1.15-metre high-grade core grading 0.68% copper, 1.26 g/t gold, and 8.84 g/t silver within 6.10 metres at 0.17% copper. The broad metal zonation pattern — copper-gold-silver grading to zinc-copper-lead-silver-gold in the surrounding sedimentary rock — is consistent with intrusion-related hydrothermal mineralisation across a 650-metre-long target trend, confirming Mista as a new discovery front within the underexplored Serpent property in a Québec jurisdiction that is increasingly relevant given the approaching Section 232 copper tariff decision.
